cases.name: video cannot be drawn
cases.result: Video "root" cannot be drawn: Android home-screen widgets cannot play video (RemoteViews has no video view); use an Image with an action that opens an app surface

cases.name: text input cannot be drawn
cases.result: TextField "root" cannot be drawn: Android home-screen widgets cannot take typed input (RemoteViews has no text box); use a Button that opens an app surface or asks Ash

cases.name: sliders cannot be drawn
cases.result: Slider "root" cannot be drawn: Android home-screen widgets cannot hold a slider (SeekBar is not allowed in RemoteViews); use a ProgressBar to show a value and Buttons to change it

cases.name: unknown components are named
cases.result: component "root" has unknown type "Foo"; widgets draw Text, Image, Icon, Row, Column, List, Card, Tabs, Divider, Button, CheckBox, ChoicePicker, Switch, Stack, Grid, Spacer, ProgressBar, Badge, Clock, Timer, Chart

cases.name: plain http images are not fetched
cases.error: plain http images are not fetched
cases.result: Image "root" url: plain http images are not fetched; use https

cases.name: svg images cannot be drawn
cases.result: Image "root" url: SVG cannot be drawn in a widget (Android decodes only bitmaps); send PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or BMP

cases.name: borders are not settable
cases.result: Text "root" style.border is not possible: RemoteViews cannot set a stroke at run time; put the element inside a Card or Stack whose background is the border colour, with padding equal to the border width

cases.name: style at the top level points into style
cases.result: Text "root" has "color" at the top level; put it in style: {color: ...}

cases.name: lists only scroll vertically
cases.result: List "root" direction horizontal: Android widgets can only scroll lists vertically; use a Row (no scrolling) or a vertical List

cases.name: a list inside a list item
cases.error: cannot scroll a list inside a list
cases.result: List "inner" is inside an item of List "root"; Android widgets cannot scroll a list inside a list

cases.name: colours are checked
